Heritage Nehru Jacket in Charcoal

₹18,999₹23,999

A structured Nehru jacket cut from handloom wool, fully lined in cotton silk, with hand-worked buttonholes and horn buttons.

The bandhgala collar has been the backbone of Indian formal dressing for a century. We have kept the proportion traditional and modernised only the shoulder.

Every jacket is cut and finished by a single tailor, whose initials are stitched inside the interior pocket.
